scope: Display-only history reading and blank-question layout; no canonical source or workspace mutation
boundary: Seonjo and later in late Joseon; actual asked event/work controls culture classification
invariant: DOM order may change; rows, fields, response IDs, source bytes, version and saved cursor remain in canonical order. Enter maps the next displayed input back to its canonical fields index.

revisedPreparedPolicy.activation: Existing readiness gate remains off. Policy is prepared from the matched PDF, not an a974 reproduction claim. Exact source/version, topic sizes, numbering, uniqueness and group totals are required at runtime. Unknown variants keep canonical presentation.
revisedPreparedPolicy.reconstructionBlocker: Private reviewed quiz panel/topic map, diagram overrides, page overrides and image classifications are not tracked in a974. Do not invent replacement review evidence.

rowReflow: Only a single valid sourceRowIndices target with same-PDF, same-page sourceVerified transcriptionAudit may attach to a physically present content cell. Explicit sourceTargetCellId wins. Ambiguous targets remain visible in source order. No raw image or PDF pixels change.
ownership: Scene assets/motion, English, auth, infrastructure, README.md and CHATGPT.md are owned by separate tasks. This branch changes only the history home function in shared index.html.
